figurative_meaning_en: to set up a temporary residence or camp
example_sentences_in_bangla: এক সাধু এসে গ্রামের বটগাছের তলায় আড্ডা গেড়েছে।
শহরে পৌঁছে তিনি একটা পার্কে আড্ডা গেড়ে থাকেন।
example_sentences_in_english: A saint came and set up his temporary camp under the village banyan tree.
Upon arriving in the city, he set up a temporary shelter in the park.
history: The idiom often references wandering sadhus (holy men) who set up temporary camps under village trees like banyan, reflecting traditional Bengali rural practices.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of transient lifestyles common among ascetics in Bengali culture.
